description.en: Reading-view enhancement for the DeepSeek Harness web client: auto-collapsing execution process, a message navigation rail, in-page search, unified failure cards, and generative MCP Apps (SEP-1865) rendered in sandboxed iframes.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness Web 客户端阅读视图增强：执行过程自动收起、消息导航导轨、页内查找、统一失败卡片，并支持在沙箱 iframe 中渲染生成式 MCP Apps（SEP-1865）。
